// diagnostic

E0070

This callable, arm, or lambda uses a retired `=>` arrow, or a `:>` that closes no `<:` fence.

What

This callable, arm, or lambda uses a retired `=>` arrow, or a `:>` that closes no `<:` fence.

Why

All arrow positions use `->`; `:>` only closes a `<: … :>` fence.

Fix

Replace the retired arrow with `->`, or add the missing `<:`. For an effect ceiling, write `-[Effects]>`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0070: tests/ui/fenced_name_stray_close.stderr.

Error [E0070]: This `:>` has no opening `<:`
  --> tests/ui/fenced_name_stray_close.jet:3:17
    |
  3 |     print(value :>)
    |                 ^^
 Why: `:>` only closes a `<: … :>` fence; callables, arms, and lambdas use one arrow: `->`
 Fix: Write `->` for an arrow, or add the missing `<:`
